column1: # Participial adjectives that keep their own analysis beside the verb form (read by `rebuild-forms`).
# Open English WordNet has an adjective entry for each spelling, but a reviewed analysis of the verb form (the past
# participle) carried the spelling and hid the adjective analysis, so that the senses of the entry could not be reached.
# Only the adjectives that technical texts use as adjectives are listed: a general rule for all 114 such entries made
# the common participles (based, covered, changed, driven) compete with the verb in the real-text evaluation, because
# the evaluation corpus labels them with the verb senses only.
